identitySignals: Agenda names 'Regents of the University of California, on behalf of its Berkeley Campus' in Berkeley, CA; the FDP Clearinghouse lists the registered entity 'REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, THE (doing business as University of California, Berkeley)' at 1608 Fourth Street, Berkeley, CA
UC Berkeley is a public university in Berkeley, CA, consistent with an education service agreement with a school district (Deputy Chief, Talent; classroom and academic programs)
WSCUC accreditor page lists University of California Berkeley, main campus in Berkeley, with www.berkeley.edu and phone 510-642-6000
research.notes: Public university governed by the Regents of the University of California. A California Secretary of State entity number was not found. The EIN and UEI come from the FDP Clearinghouse listing, not from IRS or SAM.gov directly. No general email was found. The FDP-registered address (1608 Fourth Street, Suite 220) is the sponsored projects office. The address given is the campus main address from WSCUC.

profile.legalName: REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, THE
profile.summary: The University of California, Berkeley is a public research university in Berkeley, California. It was founded in 1868 as part of the University of California system, and it offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral degrees. The Regents of the University of California is the legal entity that governs the university.

review.notes: The FDP Clearinghouse page names the legal entity as REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, THE, doing business as University of California, Berkeley, and lists EIN 94-6002123 and UEI GS3YEVSS12N6. The WSCUC page shows the campus address (200 California Hall, Berkeley, CA 94720-1500), the phone number, the website, its classification as Public, and bachelor's, master's and research doctorate programs; the Berkeley history page confirms the 1868 founding, so the neutral summary and all profile fields are supported.
